name: apartments-com/property
description: Get an Apartments.com rental property by URL with floor plans, rent, availability, amenities, fees, pet policy and contact info.

url.description: Apartments.com property URL ending in its seven-character listing ID, without query parameters. Alpha: availability may vary by location or property. Returns available fields for the requested property. Prices may represent a rental range.

timeout.description: Seconds the data source may spend before giving up (max 50, default 50). A timed-out call is not billed.
